messages:
nina-security: @channel Scheduling update: were launching a self-attestation flow for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers who need compliance evidence (ISO/SOC2/FedRAMP readiness). Beta invites go out next week. Short summary below. :calendar:

elaine: what does self-attestation include? docs?

nina-security: Its a guided checklist that customers complete in Console -> Private -> Compliance. Items: environment config (networking/isolation), encryption & key management, telemetry settings, and admin access controls. Completing the checklist generates a signed attestation PDF the customer can download and share with auditors. No new telemetry is collected by us for this process.

bob-legal: Legal checked the language. Attestations are customer-reported; were adding a statement clarifying scope and that Redwood does not certify third-party audit requirements. For FedRAMP/IL5 we still require an engagement with Security and Sales.

tom-csm: CSMs: what should we tell customers who want an exportable artifact showing audit-log retention and KMS usage?

nina-security: The attestation PDF includes config snapshots (user-chosen) and timestamps, plus links to relevant Console snapshots. Audit-log retention beyond the default is an add-on and will be reflected in the attestation if enabled. KMS integration entries show whether customer-side BYOK/HSM is in use but not key material.

audit-bot: Pilot checklist created: https://redwood.dev/internal/runbooks/private-self-attest (internal).

elaine: rollout timeline pls

nina-security: Timeline:
- Today: internal staging available for Security & CSM review.
- +7 days: pilot with 8 existing Private customers (invite-only).
- +21 days: open beta for all Private customers.
- +42 days: GA if pilot feedback is positive.

tom-csm: Please include a 1-paragraph customer-facing blurb and an FAQ for Sales. I'll handle outreach to pilot customers.

nina-security: Action items:
- @bob-legal: finalize attestation language and DPA note (ETA 48h).
- @elaine: craft customer blurb + 2-3 sentence AE email copy (ETA 72h).
- @tom-csm: curate pilot invite list (ETA 72h).

bob-legal: will send language by EOD tomorrow.

elaine: ack, prepping blurb and FAQ.

nina-security: Thanks all  DM me if you want access to the staging console or want to be on the pilot list.
